causal_account.statement: Every one of the 65 MISMATCHes is post-dating artefact movement, not documentary error. This is a fresh-context verification report whose entire numeric content — the figures it quotes from the audit draft AND the figures it independently derived as ground truth — was exactly true of its anchor artefacts on 2026-04-21. The anchors then moved in TWO independent, fully documented events: (1) the 2026-05-02/03 GT-4745 recovery campaign, which re-ran or re-aggregated all three 55-map tracks and re-evaluated them against a revised 4,745-feature ground truth, propagating to the evaluation JSONs, the Dawid-Skene results, the D-S-v1/human crosstab and the gold-standard subtype summary; and (2) commit 8e142df9c (2026-06-12) `fix(cost): regenerate 55-map cost manifests at audited flex pricing`, which rewrote all three cost manifests' totals, per-stage costs, token counts and wall-clock. Not one figure in this document was ever wrong at its own era.
causal_account.two_events_matter: The cost rows and the metric rows have DIFFERENT causes. All image and text-min cost/token/wall-clock divergences are caused solely by 8e142df9c (2026-06-12) — the 2026-05-03 recovery did not change them materially. A story that attributes the cost moves to the recovery campaign is wrong.
causal_account.falsifier: The account is refuted if ANY of the 65 quoted figures fails to reproduce from `git show c48f639e3:<anchor>` (or `git show 6b64ad0f6:<anchor>` for row 094#0[0]) at the document's own stated precision. All 65 were checked individually and all 65 reproduce. It is further refuted if any anchor has a commit touching it between 2026-04-19 and c48f639e3 — none does (checked: all ten anchor files).

quoted_vs_derived.why_it_matters: This document is itself a verification report. Its table columns are `cited_value` (what the audited draft claimed) and `actual_value` (what this verifier independently derived from the artefact). quoted_vs_derived.does_it_change_verdicts: YES, for 7 of the 9 quoted-only rows. Where the document frames a figure explicitly as another document's words — inside quotation marks (U06, line 182) or as 'draft `0.771`' (the rounding-discipline note, lines 189–193) — the truth-maker is the draft text, not the manifest. The draft was promoted to `results/documentation-audit/audit-summary.md` at c48f639e3 and STILL reads 364.70 / 0.771 / 0.795 / 91.0 % at line 44. Under correct anchoring those rows are MATCH today, not divergences, and they can never be repaired in place because charter §6 makes quoted spans verbatim. Verdict RECLASSIFY (to `historical` / quotation-of-source) for 095#21[1..4] and 095#22[0],[2],[4]. It does NOT change the 45 'both' rows: for those, cited and derived coincide (that is what PASS means), so the artefact reading dominates and SNAPSHOT-DIVERGENCE stands. Precedent inside the instrument itself: the same extractor already assigned method:`historical` to the prior-audit figures $165.74 and 90.2 % in claims 094#41 and 095#17 — it had the vocabulary and simply did not extend it to the draft's own cited_value column.
